shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,220p' src/conversationListMessages.test.ts && sed -n '1,240p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts && sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts && sed -n '1,280p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && rg -n \"validated by|specs/.*#|log\\.error\\('ws'|SERVER_ERROR\" specs src --glob '*.ts' --glob '*.md' | head -160"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "command -v lore-query-trace || true
lore-query-trace --help 2>&1 | head -80 || true
rg -n \"log\\.error\\(|jest\\.spyOn\\(log|mocked\\(log|shared/logger\" src/**/*.test.ts | head -100
rg -n \"conversation list|list_sessions|session_list\" specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
sed -n '1,180p' src/shared/logger.ts
cat package.json | sed -n '1,180p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,90p' src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts
sed -n '90,135p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
sed -n '68,84p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true
rg -n \"reanchor\" scripts ."

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/conversationListMessages.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runInBand src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "ls node_modules/.bin | rg 'reanchor|spec' || true
nl -ba src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts | rg \"answers with the authenticated|logs a rejected session\"
nl -ba src/conversationListMessages.test.ts | rg \"exports list_sessions\"
git diff --stat && git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/conversationListMessages.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts | sed -n '1,260p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts | rg \"renders the hook's sentence\"
perl -pi -e 's{(src/transport/ws/messageHandler\\.test\\.ts#L)611}{"'$1 . 643}ge'"' "'$(rg -l '"'src/transport/ws/messageHandler\\.test\\.ts#L611' specs)
git diff --name-only -- 'specs/*.md' | xargs npx prettier --write
npx re-lint-reanchor --all"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md | sed -n '1,280p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs src/conversationListMessages.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts && git commit -m "Handle conversation list store failures" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
